In the time before man walked the Earth, there are said to have been creatures that would strike fear into the heart of any who would dare to look upon them.

Today we know them as rats and spiders, snakes and scorpions.

在人类尚未行走于大地之前的时代，据说曾有种种生物，任何胆敢直视它们的人，都会胆寒彻骨。

如今，我们叫它们老鼠与蜘蛛、蛇与蝎子。

But in the age before, they had different names. Even more, they had personalities; minds that could plot and deceive.
但在更早的纪元里，它们另有名号。不仅如此，它们还有各自的性情，会谋划、会欺骗的头脑。

Page2

In all their ways they were superior to what we know today, but they all feared the light, and they shrank back into the darkness as the clouds and mist faded and the sun took more diminion from the night.

     Some say they still exist, in the deep places. If they do, few would survive to tell such tales after an encounter.

无论哪一方面，它们都胜过我们今日所知的同类；可它们都畏惧光明，当云与雾散去、太阳从夜色中夺回更多疆界，它们便退缩回黑暗里。

     有人说，在极深之处，它们依然存在。倘若如此，见过它们而又能生还讲述的人，恐怕寥寥无几。

Page2

The greatest of these was said to be the spider queen Neladra. As man rose in power, she made their cities into nests, and raised her brood on her victory.

     But she was not alone. Other creatures, foul and mighty, fought a losing battle against the daylight. In the end they perished, or possibly retreated into shelters of cold stone.

其中最强大者，据说便是蜘蛛女王内德拉拉。随着人类势力渐长，她把人类的城市筑成了巢穴，以胜利喂养她的子嗣。

     但她并非孤身。其他肮脏而强大的生物，与日光进行着一场注定失败的战争。它们最终或死灭，或退入了冰冷的石中避难所。

Some believe that all things that horrify us today are remnants of that ancient lineage; that man still remembers in his soul what transpired in those days.

      Whether the children's children of Neladra and others still remain may never be known. But if ever such a dark time is upon mankind again, look to the light.

有人相信，如今一切令我们恐惧之物，都是那支远古血脉的余孽；而人类灵魂深处，仍记得当年的旧事。

      内德拉拉之流是否还有后代存续，也许永远无人知晓。但若黑暗的时代再度笼罩人类，请望向前光明。

(written in a different handwriting than the rest of the note lies this inscription)

May history forgive me for defacing this text. But I must share a truth and I do not believe I shall live to do so, save in this book. Neladra lives. She is beneath the small town of Emerisk... I am out of time.

（以下字样与本书其他笔迹不同）

愿历史原谅我在文本上涂写。但我必须说出一个真相，而我不认为自己能活着讲出它，唯有借这本书。内德拉拉还活着。她就在小镇埃梅里斯克之下……我没时间了。
